task.description:
WF-02, step 5b, an edit of an already checked file after PASS of pass 3 (handoffs/E2E105-20261105-01/step-05f-test-design-validator.json: F6 Low, issue I1, issue I4), by decisions/0109 'Addendum 2026-11-09 (ORCH, WF-02 step 5b, after the third pass of the test gate)', О19. TEST-FIXER edits the test 'isolation' of tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js and its helpers, nothing else. The edit gets a new check (step 05h); a FAIL of that check is the third FAIL of this gate and stops the run, so measure before you write and look for surviving mutants yourself before you hand over. The code under test (tools/src, tools/test/e2e/kit/*, the stand-in, tools/README.md, package.json) is right and is not changed; tools/test/e2e-stand.test.js is not changed.

(1) Issue I1, the page of B on every screen of its own pass. Today the page text of B is read only on its card. Read it also on each question screen of B's pass and on B's result screen (wait for each screen by a fact, never by time). The page text is the textContent of the body; as the raise of the bar of О19, also document.title and the attributes aria-label, title, alt and placeholder of every element. The rule of О17 as corrected applies to the page: a text or a solution name of A that stands inside a ru text of B's tenant file is compared with the whole text of each element (and with each whole attribute value and document.title); every other text and name of A is looked for as a part of the page text. MEASURE FIRST on the correct server, both pairs, with a real browser: which texts and names of A stand inside the page texts of B on each screen, and why (a text of B's file, a fixed string of the page); the exceptions must be exactly the measured ones and pinned in the test so that they cannot grow silently. If a text of A is found on a screen of B on the correct server for another reason, stop and report it in result.issues instead of loosening anything.

(2) Issue I1, the requests of B's page: every request of the page from the open of B's address to B's result goes under B's address /t/<B>/ or to a shared path that the test names with its reason (measure the paths first; the favicon line of the kit may be one); assert that, and that nothing goes under /t/<A>/.

(3) F6, the keys: no key (at any depth) of B's questionnaire answer, B's result answer or the error answer to A's set holds a text or a solution name of A (no exception: the gate measured none); and every key of B's two answers is a key of B's tenant file or a field of the answer shape named in the test with its reason (the gate measured for B's two answers: version, lang, languages, questions_min, questions_max, ai, leads, clear_leader, recommended, score, because, value, selected; measure again yourself, and for the error answer name its own fields).

(4) Issue I4: the comment of assertNothingOf (and any other comment of the test that says where «Средний» stands) states the measured fact: «Средний» stands inside a rule text of svet-marketing's file and in none of B's answers for the leader set; the check of B's own strings catches it inside any string.

Out of criterion 6 by О19, not to be added: response headers, number values of A.

SHOW on copies outside the project, each with the assertion that catches it: the gate's G01, G01-v3, G02, G08 (keys), G05 and G06 (screens and requests) red; all earlier mutants still red (W01, W02, N05, N09 and their v3 forms, P13 and P13-v3, O1 to O7 of step 05e, G03 and G09 of step 05f); and at least six own mutants that only the new checks catch, for example: A's text shown on a question screen of B taken from A's storage key with no request; a common word of A («человек») shown as a whole element text on a screen of B; A's name in document.title of B; A's name in an aria-label on B's page; B's page asking for the questionnaire of a third tenant (not A); A's id used as a key in B's result answer. The correct code: 'isolation' alone green in a series of dozens of runs under load (AP-115) and quiet.

THEN: the changed test alone; the independence loop of the nine spec tests (each name alone: exit 0, exactly one line that starts with 'ok ', and it is 'ok 1 - <name>'); npm run -s e2e -- picker three times (one Chrome at a time) with duration_ms (say how much the new reads cost against 17 s); the two kit files three times; the counts of test( and assert. not lower than now (picker.e2e.js 144 assert., test( 12; e2e-stand.test.js 211 assert., test( 22, unchanged); npm run check once at the end, exit 0. Every edit and why the test (not the code) is to blame goes into result.changes, with the remark number (F6, I1, I4). RULES: change only tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js; no skip, no sandbox flags, no sleep (waits for facts with limits); do not commit, push or pull; kill only your own processes by explicit pid; the ten old node processes of this machine (two 'node stand.js' with a working folder outside the project, eight 'node -e setInterval') are not yours. The handoff holds no absolute machine paths and no names of the owner's other projects.
